page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The CPU configuration allocates exactly one thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources without hyperthreading.

The server is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated core allocation, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require predictable compute performance. The absence of hyperthreading and local storage makes it suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks where external block storage is utilized.
